name.text: Trigonometric Functions — exact value at a standard angle

generalfeedback.text:
The reference angle here is \({@baseangle@}^\circ\), which gives the magnitude \( |{@fname@}({@angledeg@}^\circ)| = {@fname@}({@baseangle@}^\circ) \).

The angle \({@angledeg@}^\circ\) lies in quadrant {@quadrantnum@}, where the sign of {@fname@} is {@signword@}.

So \( {@fname@}({@angledeg@}^\circ) = {@ta@} \).
